# function: ecs_service_deployment

Builds the ARN for `ecs` `service-deployment`:

```
arn:${Partition}:ecs:${Region}:${Account}:service-deployment/${ClusterName}/${ServiceName}/${ServiceDeploymentId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:ecs:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:service-deployment/cluster-name/service-name/service-deployment-id
output "ecs_service_deployment" {
  value = provider::arn::ecs_service_deployment("cluster-name", "service-name", "service-deployment-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
ecs_service_deployment(cluster_name string, service_name string, service_deployment_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `cluster_name` (String) Value for `${ClusterName}` in the ARN template.
1. `service_name` (String) Value for `${ServiceName}` in the ARN template.
1. `service_deployment_id` (String) Value for `${ServiceDeploymentId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
